title: 11. Projects: Topic 1: Classes and Objects - Projects
summary: Complete all 5 projects below. Each project should be built using the concepts learned in Topic 1.
objectives: Build the Topic 1: Classes and Objects - Projects projects end to end

sections.title: Project Instructions
sections.body: Complete all 5 projects below. Each project should be built using the concepts learned in Topic 1. Follow the process steps provided and implement the solutions independently.

sections.title: Project 1: Student Information Management System
sections.body:
### 🎯 Project Description
Build a comprehensive student information management system that can handle multiple students, their courses, grades, and attendance.

### 📋 Requirements
- Student class with personal information
- Course management functionality
- Grade tracking and GPA calculation
- Attendance monitoring
- Report generation

### 🔧 Process Steps
1. **Design the Student Class**
   - Define attributes: student_id, name, age, email, phone
   - Add methods for personal information management
   - Include validation for student data

2. **Create Course Management**
   - Design a Course class with course_id, name, credits, instructor
   - Implement course enrollment functionality
   - Add course withdrawal capabilities

3. **Implement Grade System**
   - Create a Grade class to track individual grades
   - Calculate GPA based on credit-weighted grades
   - Generate grade reports

4. **Add Attendance Tracking**
   - Track attendance for each course
   - Calculate attendance percentages
   - Generate attendance reports

5. **Build Report Generation**
   - Create methods to generate student transcripts
   - Implement attendance reports
   - Add summary statistics

6. **Test the System**
   - Create multiple student objects
   - Enroll students in various courses
   - Add grades and attendance data
   - Generate comprehensive reports

sections.title: Project 2: E-commerce Product Catalog
sections.body:
### 🎯 Project Description
Develop an e-commerce product catalog system that manages products, categories, inventory, and pricing.

### 📋 Requirements
- Product management with categories
- Inventory tracking
- Price management with discounts
- Search and filtering capabilities
- Sales analytics

### 🔧 Process Steps
1. **Design Product Class**
   - Define product attributes: id, name, description, price, category
   - Add inventory tracking attributes
   - Implement product validation

2. **Create Category System**
   - Design Category class with hierarchy support
   - Implement category management
   - Add category-based filtering

3. **Implement Inventory Management**
   - Track stock levels
   - Add low stock alerts
   - Implement stock updates

4. **Build Pricing System**
   - Support for multiple pricing tiers
   - Implement discount calculations
   - Add seasonal pricing

5. **Add Search and Filter**
   - Search by product name/description
   - Filter by category, price range
   - Sort by various criteria

6. **Create Analytics**
   - Track product popularity
   - Generate sales reports
   - Monitor inventory turnover

sections.title: Project 3: Bank Account Management System
sections.body:
### 🎯 Project Description
Create a comprehensive banking system that handles multiple accounts, transactions, and customer management.

### 📋 Requirements
- Multiple account types (Savings, Checking, Business)
- Transaction tracking and history
- Customer management
- Interest calculation
- Statement generation

### 🔧 Process Steps
1. **Design Base Account Class**
   - Create abstract account functionality
   - Implement common banking operations
   - Add transaction tracking

2. **Create Account Types**
   - Savings account with interest
   - Checking account with overdraft protection
   - Business account with special features

3. **Implement Transaction System**
   - Design Transaction class
   - Track transaction history
   - Implement transaction validation

4. **Build Customer Management**
   - Create Customer class
   - Link customers to accounts
   - Manage customer information

5. **Add Banking Features**
   - Implement interest calculations
   - Add transfer between accounts
   - Create monthly statements

6. **Security and Validation**
   - Add PIN/password protection
   - Implement transaction limits
   - Add fraud detection basics

sections.title: Project 4: Library Management System
sections.body:
### 🎯 Project Description
Build a complete library management system for book tracking, member management, and borrowing operations.

### 📋 Requirements
- Book catalog management
- Member registration and management
- Borrowing and returning system
- Fine calculation
- Report generation

### 🔧 Process Steps
1. **Design Book Class**
   - Define book attributes: isbn, title, author, genre
   - Add availability status
   - Implement book validation

2. **Create Member System**
   - Design Member class
   - Implement member registration
   - Track borrowing history

3. **Build Borrowing System**
   - Create borrowing records
   - Implement due date calculation
   - Add return functionality

4. **Implement Fine System**
   - Calculate overdue fines
   - Track fine payments
   - Generate fine reports

5. **Add Search and Catalog**
   - Search books by various criteria
   - Implement catalog browsing
   - Add book recommendations

6. **Create Management Reports**
   - Generate borrowing statistics
   - Track popular books
   - Monitor overdue items

sections.title: Project 5: Restaurant Order Management System
sections.body:
### 🎯 Project Description
Develop a restaurant management system that handles menu items, orders, tables, and billing.

### 📋 Requirements
- Menu item management
- Table reservation system
- Order processing
- Bill generation
- Kitchen order management

### 🔧 Process Steps
1. **Design Menu System**
   - Create MenuItem class
   - Implement category management
   - Add pricing and availability

2. **Build Table Management**
   - Design Table class
   - Implement reservation system
   - Track table status

3. **Create Order System**
   - Design Order class
   - Implement order items
   - Add order status tracking

4. **Implement Kitchen Interface**
   - Create kitchen order display
   - Track preparation time
   - Update order status

5. **Build Billing System**
   - Calculate order totals
   - Apply taxes and tips
   - Generate receipts

6. **Add Management Features**
   - Track daily sales
   - Monitor popular items
   - Generate business reports

sections.title: Project Development Guidelines
sections.body:
### Phase 1: Planning (30 minutes)
- Analyze requirements thoroughly
- Design class structures
- Plan method signatures
- Create data flow diagrams

### Phase 2: Core Implementation (2-3 hours)
- Implement basic classes
- Add essential methods
- Create object relationships
- Test basic functionality

### Phase 3: Advanced Features (1-2 hours)
- Add complex functionality
- Implement validation
- Create helper methods
- Add error handling

### Phase 4: Testing and Refinement (1 hour)
- Test all scenarios
- Fix bugs and issues
- Optimize code
- Add documentation

### Phase 5: Documentation (30 minutes)
- Write comprehensive comments
- Create usage examples
- Document class relationships
- Prepare presentation

sections.title: Project Submission Requirements
sections.body:
1. **Code Quality**
   - Clean, well-structured code
   - Proper naming conventions
   - Comprehensive comments
   - Error handling

2. **Functionality**
   - All requirements implemented
   - Proper object relationships
   - Working test cases
   - User-friendly interface

3. **Documentation**
   - README file with setup instructions
   - Class and method documentation
   - Usage examples
   - Architecture explanation

4. **Testing**
   - Multiple test scenarios
   - Edge case handling
   - Performance considerations
   - User acceptance testing

sections.title: Learning Outcomes
sections.body:
After completing these projects, you will:
- Master class and object creation
- Understand complex system design
- Learn proper code organization
- Develop problem-solving skills
- Build real-world applications
- Gain confidence in OOPs concepts

**Complete all projects before moving to Topic 2: Inheritance!**
